title: ISRO And ANTRIX
definition: ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) is India's national space agency under the Department of Space (DoS), while Antrix Corporation Limited is its wholly-owned commercial arm incorporated to market space products and services globally.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper III (Science and Technology - Space Technology, Achievements of Indians in Science & Tech, Commercialization of Space, and Institutional Frameworks). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding corporate entities of DoS and international commercial agreements.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of ISRO And ANTRIX.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of India's space program history
